description.content: The Inventory APIs provide the ability to fetch Hotel Room Type Inventory and manage overbooking/sell limits at different levels. It also contains operations to get item inventory for a property.

You can use this API to retrieve the inventory for a specified hotel. Narrow down your results using the query parameters such as a date range, room type, room class, and/or tentative inventory included.

OperationId:getHotelInventory

This API allows a time span of 90 days.
